note: GFP recreation area on Lake Thompson (state's largest natural lake), 6 mi southwest of Lake Preston off US-14. The campground fills a wooded peninsula on the south shore: gravel back-in electric sites in several connected loops, six tent-only sites, five camping cabins and a group lodge. The gravel Campground Shoreline Trail runs between the south loops and the water. Swim beach, boat ramp and fish-cleaning station. --Claude
